title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before busking or performing in streets or other public places.

laws.title: Shire of Wagin Activities on Thoroughfares and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2001

sources.title: Shire of Wagin Activities on Thoroughfares and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2001 (adopting the Kojonup local law)
sources.locator: cl 6.10 of the Kojonup local law, as made, Gazette No. 88, 16 May 2000; adopted with modifications, Gazette No. 235, 4 Dec 2001
sources.quote: A person shall not perform in a public place without a permit.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. The council adopted the Kojonup local law with modifications (Gazette No. 235, 4 Dec 2001); the clause is quoted from that law as made.

assessment.summary: Performing in public places needs the council's permit.
